## Why would this be useful to the OBS community?

## Eligibility Checklist

Please check all that apply:

- [ ] I have checked the [README](https://github.com/Pralhad-Nasane/awesome-obs/blob/main/README.md) and open issues/PRs to ensure this is not a duplicate
- [ ] The resource has publicly accessible source code
- [ ] The software is covered by a valid, OSI-approved open-source license
- [ ] The project is maintained, functional, and not archived
- [ ] The project works with at least one currently supported stable version of OBS Studio (external tools independent of an OBS version are exempt)
